name: Olgar
source:
The Leader of the Hawk Clan. Lugus and Tee's father.
He governs the town using sheer strength.
He has a brutal personality and is merciless towards those who face his wrath.
He is feared by many people in the town.

[From [url=https://www.otomate.jp/psychedelica/aa-nisus/chara/?page=olga]official website[/url]]
